page_title: RSO 2-0 LEV | Real Sociedad v Levante 04/04/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's the end of the match.
90+5' A cross by Dela (Levante) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
90+4' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Orri Oskarsson (Real Sociedad) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.

90+4' Carlos Espi (Levante) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Alex Remiro pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.

90+3' Carlos Soler (Real Sociedad) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
90+2' Jeremy Toljan (Levante) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle for an infringement. Real Sociedad get a free kick.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
89' The statistic for corner kicks – 11:5. Let's have a look at statistics for the fouls committed by both teams – 8:13.

89' Carlos Espi (Levante) finds himself some space inside the box, collects a rebound and sends an effort in on goal. Alex Remiro pulls off a fantastic reflex save to stop the ball going low into the middle of the target.

88' So close! Pablo Martinez Andres (Levante) delivers a cross into the box, it almost finds the head of one of his teammates, but one of the defenders is quickest to the ball and coolly deals with the threat.
87' Jon Martin (Real Sociedad) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee. Jon Martin (Real Sociedad) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
86' Orri Oskarsson (Real Sociedad) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the right post.
85' A substitution has been made. Benat Turrientes (Real Sociedad) goes off and Ibai Aguirre comes on.
85' Orri Oskarsson joins the action as a substitute, replacing Goncalo Guedes (Real Sociedad).

83' 2 - 0 It's a goal! Pablo Marin plays a lovely pass into the box and finds Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad). He tries his luck from close range and coolly strikes the ball into the back of the net. 2:0.
82' Ugo Raghouber (Levante) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
81' Luis Castro has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Tai Abed (Levante) replacing Victor Garcia.
80' Jon Ander Olasagasti (Levante) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
79' Half-chance! Victor Garcia (Levante) plays a pass into the box, but Alex Remiro reacts well to snuff out the attack.
78' Ugo Raghouber (Levante) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Alex Remiro comes off the line to clear the ball away.
76' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) prepares to take a corner kick.
75' OFF THE BAR! Goncalo Guedes (Real Sociedad) unleashes a thunderous effort from the edge of the box and the ball crashes off the woodwork. What a strike that was!
74' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
73' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. Real Sociedad win a corner.
71' The total number of attempts is 15:4. The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 4:2.
70' The goalkeeper punched the ball away after Pablo Martinez Andres (Levante) took the corner.

70' Carlos Espi (Levante) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Levante.
69' A substitution has been made. Duje Caleta-Car is replaced by Aritz Elustondo (Real Sociedad).
67' PENALTY APPEAL after Carlos Espi (Levante) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
65' A precise cross towards the edge of the box was latched onto by Alan Matturro (Levante) . He outjumped the defence and produced a powerful header which goes a whisker over the crossbar.
65' Pablo Martinez Andres (Levante) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
65' Pablo Martinez Andres (Levante) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Now Levante have a corner.
64' Pellegrino Matarazzo has decided to make a change. Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) replaces Luka Sucic.
63' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) doesn't have to suffer any longer with the painful injury as Pablo Marin comes onto the pitch to replace him.
62' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
61' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) cracks a shot goalwards from the edge of the box, but his radar is off and it sails well wide of the left post.
60' Ivan Romero (Levante) strikes a bullet of a shot towards goal from distance and forces the goalkeeper to make a good save.
59' Here is a change. Oriol Rey is going off and Luis Castro gives the last tactical orders to Ugo Raghouber (Levante).
59' Substitution. Kareem Tunde makes his way off the pitch and Ivan Romero (Levante) comes on as his replacement.
55' Luka Sucic (Real Sociedad) gets a shot from the edge of the box, but it crashes against the crossbar!
54' Carlos Espi (Levante) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
54' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

54' Carlos Soler (Real Sociedad) latched on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and immediately slams the ball towards the top right corner. His effort was thwarted by the alert goalkeeper, who pulled off a stunning save. The referee blows his whistle, Real Sociedad are awarded a corner kick.
53' Mathew Ryan comes off his line to intercept the corner from Carlos Soler (Real Sociedad).

53' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) was all set to receive a beautiful pass into a promising position. However, one of the defenders makes a timely clearance. The ball goes out of play. Real Sociedad are awarded a corner kick.
51' The attendance for today's match is 27000.
50' Carlos Soler (Real Sociedad) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.

50' Goncalo Guedes (Real Sociedad) latches on to a precise pass and one-on-one with the keeper slams the ball towards the left-hand post. Mathew Ryan is alert, though, and leaps like a salmon to deny him.
49' Victor Garcia (Levante) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
48' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
46' The game is over for Matias Moreno (Levante). Alan Matturro comes on for the second half.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Iker Losada (Levante) comes off for Pablo Martinez Andres.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+2' Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
45' Goncalo Guedes (Real Sociedad) is repeatedly being caught offside, but this is to be expected given that he always plays on the shoulder of the last defender.

43' Jon Ander Olasagasti (Levante) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Iker Losada, but he can't get on the end of the pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Real Sociedad.
42' The resulting corner from Carlos Soler (Real Sociedad) is cleared.

41' Goncalo Guedes (Real Sociedad) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked. The ball is out of play. Real Sociedad will have a chance to score from a corner.
40' Goncalo Guedes (Real Sociedad) latches onto a rebound in the box and fires a shot just over the bar. That was a promising chance and maybe he should have done better!
39' Kareem Tunde (Levante) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Alex Remiro, who smothers the ball.

38' Jon Martin (Real Sociedad) missed a great opportunity! He finds himself some space near the penalty spot and plants a header goalwards which lacks both power and accuracy. The ball goes well wide of the right post!
38' A cross from the free kick is whipped in by Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad), but one of the defenders steps in and averts the threat.
37' A clumsy foul by Victor Garcia (Levante) and Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle. Real Sociedad earn a free kick.
36' Iker Losada (Levante) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
35' A pass into the penalty area from Iker Losada (Levante) is intercepted by the defence. Levante force their opponents to concede a corner.
34' A dangerous looking corner kick from Jon Ander Olasagasti (Levante) is cleared to safety by the defence.

33' Kareem Tunde (Levante) has a sight of goal and shoots towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper makes a superb save. The ball goes behind for a corner. Levante will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
33' 7:1 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams. The number of shots on goal at present is 3:0.
31' Luis Castro is stunned as referee Alejandro Ruiz shows him a yellow card. What was that for?

30' 1 - 0 Jon Martin (Real Sociedad) jumped highest to meet a perfectly executed corner kick by Carlos Soler. His header was precise and ended up in the back of the net, leaving the goalkeeper flapping in the wind. The score is 1:0.
30' Carlos Soler (Real Sociedad) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.

29' Benat Turrientes (Real Sociedad) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders. Corner kick. Real Sociedad will have an opportunity.
28' Neat passing move from Real Sociedad in order to create new attacking opportunities.
25' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Luka Sucic, but Mathew Ryan displays great awareness to stop him.
25' Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. It's a throw-in for Levante.

24' Good touch by Jon Ander Olasagasti (Levante) as he receives a great pass and attempts to threaten the goalkeeper with his long-range strike. Unfortunately for him, the effort misses the net and flies well wide to the right.
24' Victor Garcia (Levante) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
21' Ander Barrenetxea almost gets into in a promising position, but the through ball by Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) from just inside the box is intercepted by one of the defending players.
21' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) picks up a pass inside the box and finds some space for a shot before unleashing a low drive goalwards, but one of the defending players blocks his effort.

19' Jon Aramburu sprays a wonderful pass out to Goncalo Guedes (Real Sociedad), who cannot get enough power or direction to cause Mathew Ryan problems and the goalkeeper is able to watch the ball go just wide of the left post.
17' The game is interrupted. Matias Moreno (Levante) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
17' The possession of the ball – 56:44.
16' Sergio Gomez bends the corner in towards the goal and finds Jon Martin (Real Sociedad) almost on the goal line, but he somehow contrives to head the ball high over the bar.
16' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
16' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The referee signals a corner kick to Real Sociedad.
15' The referee is firm and issues Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) a deserved yellow card.
15' Manu Sanchez (Levante) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
13' Kareem Tunde (Levante) and Iker Losada attempt to exchange short two-yard passes, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
13' Victor Garcia (Levante) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
11' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) storms into the box to get on the end of a pass, but smashes his shot straight onto the left post. Unlucky!
10' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
9' Dela (Levante) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.
6' Luka Sucic (Real Sociedad) tackles a bit over-zealously and Alejandro Ruiz blows for a foul. Levante win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
5' Luka Sucic (Real Sociedad) touches the ball with his hand.
4' Goncalo Guedes (Real Sociedad) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
3' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) takes it short.
3' Good defending. Luka Sucic (Real Sociedad) tries to find Mikel Oyarzabal inside the box, but the pass is cut out. The referee points to the corner flag and Real Sociedad will take a corner.
2' Victor Garcia (Levante) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
2' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.

1' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) drills a low shot from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort. The ball heads towards the left post, but the goalkeeper denies him with a fantastic save. The ball goes out of play. Real Sociedad are awarded a corner kick.
